''''Jade Hills Extended'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It is a wider version of [['Jade Hills']], featuring an extra mountain and more trees. It can be purchased from the [[Oasis]] on Wednesdays for {{Price|5000}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
